source: Estimator's Bluebeam count markups on 'Combined drawing - take off' (one polygon per device). Colour → device read by inspecting the symbol under a sample of each colour against the drawing's own legend (F1000).
notes: Sheet 2 (ground floor demolition) markups count existing items to be removed (mixed types) and are not scored. Sprinklers (semi-recessed red, upright orange, concealed-space black) and speakers (recessed dark green, surface light green) are scored at family level.
